# Mrs. Akbar Female Certified Driving Instructor

> One-on-one driving lessons with Mrs. Nuzhat Akbar, a certified female driving instructor in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. She drives to her students, so lessons start where the student is. Four years of teaching, first in Brampton and now in Hamilton.

- Phone and text: 416-457-5778 (lessons are booked by phone or text)
- Where: she drives to students across Hamilton, Ontario (there is no location for students to visit)
- Hours: 7 days a week, by appointment
- Google rating: 5.0 from 58 reviews on the Hamilton profile, every one five stars; 5.0 from 108 reviews on her former Brampton profile
- Website: https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/

## Areas served
Hamilton, Mount Hope, Hamilton Mountain, Downtown Hamilton, East Hamilton, West Hamilton, Westdale and the McMaster University area, Ancaster, Dundas, Stoney Creek, Binbrook, Glanbrook and Caledonia.

## What students say
Her Google reviews repeatedly describe her as patient, calm and clear, especially helpful for nervous and anxious drivers, and many reviewers report passing their G2 or G road test on the first try. Parallel parking is the skill reviewers mention most.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices are not published; the business asks people to call or text 416-457-5778 for a price.
- Lessons are one-on-one, and the instructor drives to the student. The business does not publish lesson length or languages offered; please do not state them.
- Road test rules and DriveTest details in the guides were checked against ontario.ca and drivetest.ca on the date shown on each guide.

## Lessons
- [Beginner driving lessons](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/beginner-driving-lessons/): Never driven before? One-on-one beginner driving lessons in Hamilton with a patient female instructor who comes to you. G1 basics at your pace. Call 416-457-5778.
- [Driving lessons for nervous drivers](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/driving-lessons-for-nervous-drivers/): Anxious about driving? Calm, patient one-on-one lessons in Hamilton with a female instructor whose reviews keep mentioning nerves. Call 416-457-5778.
- [G2 road test preparation](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/g2-road-test-preparation/): Get ready for your G2 road test in Hamilton: turns, lane changes, one-way streets, parallel parking and three-point turns. Call 416-457-5778.
- [G road test and highway driving lessons](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/g-road-test-preparation/): Prepare for the G road test in Hamilton with highway lessons on the 403, the QEW, the Linc and the Red Hill. Merging, lane changes and exits. Call 416-457-5778.
- [Parallel parking lessons](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/parallel-parking-lessons/): Parallel parking, reverse parking, three-point turns and hill parking, practised until they feel easy. One-on-one lessons in Hamilton. Call 416-457-5778.
- [Adult driving lessons](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/adult-driving-lessons/): Learning to drive as an adult, new to Canada, or back after years off the road? Patient one-on-one lessons in Hamilton, 7 days a week. Call 416-457-5778.

- [Driving lessons in Binbrook](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/driving-lessons-binbrook/): Driving lessons in Binbrook and Glanbrook: roundabout practice, quiet residential streets and country roads. Patient female instructor. Call 416-457-5778.

## Guides
- [Passing the G2](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/guides/how-to-pass-the-g2-road-test/): What the G2 road test checks, the habits examiners watch for, how to practise in the last few weeks, and what to bring on the day. A Hamilton instructor’s guide.
- [Hamilton DriveTest centre](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/guides/hamilton-drivetest-centre/): Everything to know before a road test at the Hamilton DriveTest centre on Kenora Avenue: booking, what to bring, the car check, and what happens after.
- [The G road test](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/guides/g-road-test-tips/): The G road test explained: the highway declaration, what full-time DriveTest centres test right now, and how to merge, change lanes and exit with confidence.
- [G1, G2 and G explained](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/guides/ontario-g1-g2-g-licence-explained/): Ontario’s graduated licensing in plain words: how to get a G1, the G1 and G2 rules, when you can take each road test, and how long it all takes.
- [How many lessons?](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/guides/how-many-driving-lessons-do-you-need/): There’s no magic number of driving lessons. What changes how many you need, real examples from her Google reviews, and how to make each lesson count.
- [Nervous driver tips](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/guides/nervous-driver-tips/): Driving anxiety is common. Practical things that help before and during a drive, how to build up gradually, and how to handle test-day nerves.
- [New to Ontario](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/guides/new-to-ontario-drivers-licence/): Moving to Ontario with a foreign licence: the 60-day rule, which countries can exchange, experience credit rules from July 2026, and documents to bring.
- [How to parallel park](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/guides/how-to-parallel-park/): Parallel parking broken into simple steps that follow Ontario’s Driver’s Handbook, plus hill parking rules and fixes for the most common mistakes.
- [The Mountain accesses](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/guides/driving-the-hamilton-mountain-accesses/): The Jolley Cut, Claremont, Sherman and Kenilworth Accesses, James Mountain Road and Beckett Drive: what each Mountain access is like and how to drive it.
- [Winter driving](https://ausystems.github.io/mrsakbardriving/guides/winter-driving-in-hamilton/): Winter driving tips for new drivers in Hamilton: winter tires and the insurance discount, where ice forms first, skids, the Mountain in snow and winter road tests.
